messages:
Olivia K: Morning — quick heads-up for today's release train. Need someone to take the 21:00 EOD lane (small runtime + API change). Who can own smoke and rollback readiness? :wave:
Sam T: I can take the lane if nobody else already grabbed it. I have the slot free and I'm on call tonight. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: I'll own the smoke checks. Will run the usual flow and report back. @Sam T, can you confirm the target commit sha and the canary percentage?
Sam T: Target commit is f3a2b9d. Canary at 10% for 20m, then 50% for 10m if metrics look good.
Jen R: 👋 adding a quick CR ping — runtime change LGTM but left one comment on the perf test. If smoke shows elevated token-latency, we should roll back.
Maria P: Deploy-bot scheduled the window: 21:00-21:30 UTC, reserved slot EOD-3. See deploy-bot msg below.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: EOD-3 @21:00 UTC. Owner: unassigned. Reminder: attach smoke run output to the thread.
Olivia K: Sam — assigning owner to you now. Please coordinate with Kevin on smoke checklist. I'll hold the rollback authority if needed.
Sam T: Assigned. Kevin — i'll ping you 20m before deploy to start warmup and pre-smoke.
Kevin L: Plan for smoke:
```
# pre-smoke (20m before)
kubectl rollout status deployment/runtime-service -n prod
curl -sS https://api.prod.redwood.ai/health | jq .
# post-canary check
curl -sS https://api.prod.redwood.ai/metrics | jq .
# latency spot-check
wrk -t2 -c50 -d10s https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Kevin L: I'll paste the smoke summary here. If any of the checks fail (non-2xx or p95 token latency > 220ms), we plan immediate rollback.
Jen R: Rollback plan note: rollback tag is release/f3a2b9d-rollback. Trigger job: prod-rollback (Jenkins) or use `./deploy/rollback.sh release/f3a2b9d`.
Sam T: Got it. I will also watch for error-rate > 0.5% and increased 5xxs. If we see that, pause the rollout and tag for rollback.
Olivia K: Minor ops note — please run the cache-warmup before canary to avoid cold-start blips. `curl` warmup to `/v1/ping` x20.
Maria P: Confirmed runbook link: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/release-train/runbook-eod. Please attach logs.
Sam T: Will attach smoke logs and metrics link once done. Also will capture run id from deploy-bot.
Kevin L: Pre-smoke ping at 20:40 UTC. I can be on standby in #eng-oncall if anyone needs me live.
Jen R: If rollback happens, I'll open the PR revert and notify infra. Quick template: "Revert runtime perf tweak — revert f3a2b9d"
Olivia K: Thanks team. Short checklist: Sam = owner, Kevin = smoke, Jen = rollback + CR lead, Maria = deploy-window ops. Ping me if anything changes. :raised_hands:
Sam T: Sounds good. Will update the thread after pre-smoke and again post-canary.
Kevin L: Pre-smoke started at 20:40 UTC — running health + smoke scripts now.
Sam T: Pre-smoke looks good. Health 200, p95 token-latency ~180ms. Proceeding with canary.
Kevin L: Canary at 10% started. Monitoring metrics.
Sam T: Canary steady, no spike in 5xx. Increasing to 50%.
Kevin L: Post-canary summary: 200 OK, p95 190ms, 5xx 0.1%. No rollback. Attaching logs: gist.github.com/kevinl/smoke-eod-5387654321
Olivia K: Great job — closing the handoff. Marking slot as complete. :tada:
